name: Lyo.Images.Ocr
tagline: Engine-agnostic **OCR contracts** for Lyo: **`IOcrEngine`**, request/response models, **Y-up pixel bounding boxes** (aligned with `BoundingBox2D`), coordinate helpers, and shared…
description:
Engine-agnostic **OCR contracts** for Lyo: **`IOcrEngine`**, request/response models, **Y-up pixel bounding boxes** (aligned with
[`BoundingBox2D`](../../../Core/Common/Lyo.Common/Records/BoundingBox2D.cs)), coordinate helpers, and shared **`OcrEngineOptions`**.

Implementations (e.g. **`Lyo.Images.Ocr.Tesseract`**) register **`IOcrEngine`**. This package only registers cross-provider options via **`AddOcrEngineOptions`** /
**`AddOcrEngineOptionsFromConfiguration`**.

examples.title: Configuration (2)

sections.title: Public API
rows: `ReadAsync(Stream imageStream, OcrReadRequest?, CancellationToken) → Task<Result<OcrPageResult>>` — runs OCR on an encoded raster stream (PNG/JPEG/etc.).
Word + line records used in `OcrPageResult`. `OcrWord.BoundingBoxPixels` is a `BoundingBox2D` (Y-up).
`FromTopLeftDownwardRect`, `MapPixelBoxToPdfPoints`, and other helpers to convert between raster, Y-up pixel, and PDF point coordinates.
Metric name and error code constants for engines to use consistently.

sections.title: Bounding boxes
items: **`OcrWord.BoundingBoxPixels`** uses **Y-up** coordinates: origin at the **bottom-left** of the image, so **`Top` > `Bottom`** and **`Height = Top - Bottom`** matches [`BoundingBox2D`](../../../Core/Common/Lyo.Common/Records/BoundingBox2D.cs).
Use **`OcrCoordinateTransforms.FromTopLeftDownwardRect`** to convert typical top-left raster rects (e.g. Tesseract) into this form.
For PDF overlay with a rendered page, use **`OcrCoordinateTransforms.MapPixelBoxToPdfPoints`** (see **`Lyo.Pdf.Ocr`**).
